retrieved_synopses: This scene occurs immediately after the assault on the Druid Grove: the Emerald Grove has been saved, grove leaders (like Halsin) have returned and already sensed the player's illithid tadpole. The player is in possession of the Orpheus artefact and is being confronted by gith sentries and an inquisitor (e.g., Inquisitor W'wargaz or Captain Therezzyn) who are aware of the player's recent violent deeds and suspect the relic may be a githyanki “weapon.” The sentries will admit you if you convincingly appear gith, produce the box/artifact, or persuade them you have a legitimate reason to be at the crèche — Lae'zel invoking Vlaakith or an explicit threat can sway them. Handing the artefact over (or killing the inquisitor) is known to summon Vlaakith through a planecaster and can result in the player being teleported to the Astral Prison.
The guards can be convinced to let you in if you are Gith-looking or have obtained the insignia.

The player sees two Githyanki guards dragging three cultists in the monastery. One of the cultists - upon realising they're looking for some sort of weapon and failing to plead ignorance - makes a break for it. The gith guard kills him. The guards order the two remaining inside, pointing at the gate, before cutting to gameplay.

Our party encounters a band of githyanki warriors who have taken position at bottleneck in the region - a bridge that provides one of the few paths of progression. The gith confront us and try to see if we know anything about the 'weapon' they seek. (The weapon in question is the strange puzzle box we are carrying.) While reading our thoughts, the githyanki may realise we are tadpoled, resulting in instant combat. If we manage to conceal our tadpoles, they may allow us to pass.

context: This scene occurs immediately after the assault on the Druid Grove: the Emerald Grove has been secured and grove leaders (like Halsin) have returned and already sensed the player's illithid tadpole. The player is carrying the Orpheus artefact (the strange puzzle box) and is being confronted at the crèche's upper checkpoint by gith sentries (e.g., Gish Far'aag) and an inquisitor (Inquisitor W'wargaz or Captain Therezzyn) who are wary of your recent violent deeds and suspect the relic may be a githyanki weapon. The guards will admit you only if you convincingly appear gith, produce the box or insignia, or persuade them you have a legitimate reason to be at the crèche — Lae'zel invoking Vlaakith or an explicit threat can sway them. Be aware that handing the artefact over (or killing the inquisitor) is known to summon Vlaakith via a planecaster and can result in teleportation to the Astral Prison.
